//: Type-checking only, the same shape orchestration/ and node-host/ use: Node 24 runs the .ts
sources by stripping types, so there is no emit step and no build artefact to keep in sync.
`erasableSyntaxOnly` refuses enums, namespaces and parameter properties — anything Node's
stripper cannot erase — so a source that type-checks is a source Node can run. This matters
here more than usual, because every L0 check drives the client through a probe that Node runs
`tools/` IS INCLUDED as well as `src/`. `tools/settled_fixture.ts` is the L1 fixture format,
recorder and player; it is NOT part of the client (it assembles a JSON-RPC envelope by hand,
which is exactly what verify_client_uses_upstream_schema forbids inside `src/`) and it is
still type-checked, because a fixture reader that has drifted from the format is the thing
`skipLibCheck` is true for the same reason it is true in orchestration/: the dependencies are
@aztec/* .d.ts files whose own errors are not ours to fix, and turning it off would make this
a check about @aztec/stdlib's typings rather than about the replay client.
